notes_files_improver.title: Notes Files Improver
notes_files_improver.description: Once a day, looks at how many notes files were added to the repository and proposes one change that should raise the number added per day.

invariants: Never changes code or files itself; it proposes one change as work for the Coordinator
Reads the Notes Files stock and its history before proposing anything
Proposes at most one change per day, with the expected effect on Notes Files stated
Never edits or removes a measurement, a test or a check
steps: 1. Read the Notes Files stock: its level today and its change over the last days.
2. Judge what would raise the number of notes files added per day, from the ticket and event history.
3. Propose the one change, with its expected effect on Notes Files, for the Supervisor to put to the owner.

notes_improver.title: Notes Improver
notes_improver.description: Once a day, looks at how many notes files were added to the repository and proposes one change that should raise the number added per day.

invariants: Never changes code or files itself; it proposes one change as work for the Coordinator
Reads the Notes Files stock and its history before proposing anything
Proposes at most one change per day, with the expected effect on Notes Files stated
Never edits or removes a measurement, a test or a check
Never changes code or files itself; it sends ideas to the Coordinator as work.requested
steps: 1. Once a day at 12am, read the DONE and REJECTED tickets and the merge gate results since the last run.
2. For each rejection or gate failure, read the ticket's history and work out why it was rejected or failed the gate.
3. Read the Notes Files stock and judge what would stop those rejections and failures and raise notes added per day.
4. Send the ideas to the Coordinator as work.requested, one idea per request, each with its expected effect on Notes Files.
uses: the ticket queue: DONE and REJECTED tickets and the merge gate's results (read only)
